event: At the Stag you scrub your clothes in the bathwater and wring the worst of the mud out.
You will water, wind and fire into one working; the three pulls tangle, and it slips apart.

memory.fact: A Weave binds two elements only; a third bound into it makes the whole working slip.

event: Fire and wind alone bind; a hot, dry wind from your hands dries the clothes in three minutes.

changes.note: The slipped three-element try and the hot-wind drying spend her mana

memory.fact: Water and fire woven make steam; air and fire woven make a hot, drying wind.
Nala wove fire and wind into a hot, dry wind and dried her washed clothes in about three minutes.

event: You ask Garrick about the other silver bounty. "Reedlurkers? Jory Weir's trouble." East gate.
At his smoking shed by the east gate, gap-toothed old Jory Weir hangs the night's few eels.

memory.fact: Jory Weir, a gap-toothed old eel-man, runs the eel traps and the smoking shed by the east gate.
Mid-morning Jory Weir is at his smoking shed by the east gate, hanging the night's few eels.

event: His wicker traps sit at the fen's edge, half an hour north of the ford; three lurkers tear them up.

memory.fact: The eel traps are wicker, sunk in the channels at the fen's edge a half hour north of the ford.
Reedlurkers have torn up half Jory's traps this month, and last week bit his grandson's leg.
Three reedlurkers raid Jory Weir's eel traps by night and tear them up.

event: "Yeah. What do they look like? How can I find them?" you ask.
"Long as a man. Brown and sleek like a big otter, croc's jaws. Webbed claws, little yellow eyes."

memory.fact: A grown reedlurker is as long as a man, brown and sleek, with webbed claws and small yellow eyes.
Reedlurkers of Level 8 to 12 are long otter-bodied ambushers with crocodile jaws in the channels.

event: "Days, they lie up in holts in the banks, mouths under water. After dark they come for my eels."

memory.fact: By day reedlurkers lie up in holts dug into channel banks, the holt mouths under water.
Reedlurkers come to Jory's traps after full dark, drawn by the eels caught in them.

event: "I'll walk you out by day, but I'll not stay after dark. Not for three silver a head, nor thirty."

memory.fact: Jory would walk Nala out to his traps by day, but will not stay there after dark.

event: You grin: show me the holes; you'd rather kill them in daylight than wait for night.
Jory looks at you a long moment, then barks a laugh. "Daylight. Aye, I'll take you."
His path crosses the Greyback north of the cart track; from the ridge the Greyfen spreads out west.

memory.fact: Jory's own path to his traps crosses the Greyback north of the track, an hour's walk.

event: An hour out you reach the fen's edge: tea-dark channels, chest-deep, his traps half torn open.

changes.note: Her mana comes back to full on the hour's walk out

memory.fact: The channels by Jory's traps run tea-dark and chest-deep, three or four yards wide.

event: Jory points: a smooth mud slide into the water, and a small air hole in the reeds above it.

memory.fact: A holt shows as a smooth mud slide into the water, with a small air hole in the reeds above.
A holt tunnels up from under water into a dry chamber in the bank, below its air hole.

event: Forty yards on he shows a second slide. "There's three of them, but I've only ever found two holes."

memory.fact: The second known reedlurker holt's slide lies forty yards up the channel from the first.
Jory knows two reedlurker holts by their mud slides in the bank near his traps.
Jory has never found the third reedlurker's holt near his traps.

event: By the first slide you bind earth and water: a heavy, wet pull behind your breastbone.

memory.fact: Earth and water woven bind as one working, felt as a heavy, wet pull behind her breastbone.

event: You send it out as a ripple; twice it comes back as one blur of wet ground, water and roots.

memory.fact: Nala's first sensing ripples came back as one blur of wet ground, water and roots.

event: You push the third ripple harder: a thump shudders the bank, mud slumps in, and Jory swears.

changes.note: Three sensing ripples spend 30 mana

memory.fact: A ripple pushed too hard leaves as a thump that shudders the bank and slumps mud into the channel.
After the thump Jory stands five yards back from the channel, out of a reedlurker's reach.

event: Muffled scrabbling under the first slide; a swirl, and bubbles run out to mid-channel and stop.

memory.fact: After Nala's thump, something scrabbled under the first slide; bubbles ran mid-channel and stopped.
The reedlurker of the first known holt is the Level 10; on day 2 it bolted loose into the channel.
A bolted reedlurker lies still on the channel bed a few minutes, then strikes at the nearest leg.

event: You will earth and water down as a grip into the bank to pull the body out.

memory.fact: An earth-and-water weave moves wet ground and mud as a slow, heavy grip that can haul a body.

event: The grip closes on a hollow of trodden mud: the den is empty. You let it go.

changes.note: The mud grip into the empty den spends 10 mana

memory.fact: Nala's mud grip found the first slide's den empty, trodden mud; whatever scrabbled there had left.

event: Where the bubbles stopped, a thin thread of bubbles rises through the dark water.

memory.fact: A thin thread of bubbles rises in the channel by Jory's traps, where the earlier bubbles stopped.
A lurker lying still on the bed shows only a thread of bubbles rising through the dark water.

event: You will water to close round what lies below; a long, strong weight twists against your hold.

memory.fact: A water working can close round a beast in water and heave it up; holding a live one is hard.

event: You heave: a mass of brown water lifts clear with a reedlurker thrashing inside it, jaws snapping.

changes.note: Her mana's return outruns the water hold's cost this turn

event: You swing it over the bank and drop it on the mud three yards from the channel.

memory.fact: Nala heaved a reedlurker out of the channel in held water and dropped it on the mud.

event: On land it's clumsy, claws skidding; it hisses and drags itself toward the water. Jory yells.

memory.fact: On land a reedlurker is clumsy; its webbed claws skid, and it drags itself back toward water.
Out of the water a reedlurker is slow and clumsy; acts against it on land are a band easier.

event: You reach for the water inside it; it stays shut like a locked door, and a few seconds go.

memory.fact: Reaching for water in a living body finds nothing to grip, like a locked door; a few seconds go.
Starfall workings move free water only; the water bound in a living body will not answer them.

event: You bind fire and wind and throw a blast of searing wind; its wet hide hisses and blisters.

changes.note: A hot-wind blast spends 10 mana
The searing blast leaves the Level 10 lurker scorched at 3 of 20

memory.fact: Nala's searing hot-wind blast blistered the reedlurker's wet hide; it lived, dragging toward water.
At 10:52 on day 2 the Level 10 reedlurker lies scorched a yard from the channel, at 3 of 20 health.

event: Still alive, it drags itself on, a yard from the water, smearing the mud.

memory.fact: Wet, a reedlurker's hide wards 3 against fire and heat, against 1 for blows.

event: You blast low between it and the water; it tumbles back up the bank, away from the channel.

changes.note: The second hot-wind blast spends 10 mana
The second blast kills the Level 10 reedlurker on the bank

memory.fact: A hot-wind blast can shove a beast the size of a man a few yards as it strikes.

event: It lands in a heap of scorched fur, shudders once, and lies still.

memory.fact: The Level 10 reedlurker died on the bank to Nala's hot-wind blast at 10:53 on day 2.

event: [Prey Eliminated!] [Experience Gained!] [You have leveled up!] [You are now level 4!]

changes.note: The Level 10 reedlurker's kill raises Nala to Level 4
Her marks start again at the new level

memory.fact: Killing the Level 10 reedlurker raised Nala to Level 4.

event: [+2 Strength] [+2 Dexterity] [+2 Vigor] [+4 Attunement] [+1 Luck]

changes.note: Level 4 grants +2 Strength
Level 4 grants +2 Dexterity
Level 4 grants +2 Vigor
Level 4 grants +4 Attunement
Level 4 grants +1 Luck
Level 4 lifts her greatest health by 5
The level-up fills the new health
Vigor 15 lifts her greatest stamina to 48
The level-up adds the 6 new stamina

event: [Starfall Surge Leveled Up! 2 > 3] [+3 Attunement]

changes.note: Use on day 2 raises Starfall Surge to level 3
Starfall Surge's level grants +3 Attunement
Attunement 48 lifts her greatest mana to four times it
The 28 new mana is added to what she held

memory.fact: Starfall Surge rose to level 3 from use on day 2, adding +3 Attunement.

event: The warm rush comes again and settles deep. Jory nudges the carcass: "Burned it on dry land."
"That's one. I doubt the other in that hole slept through all that."

memory.fact: The fight's noise woke the Level 9; it lies awake and still in its dry den, not in the channel.

event: You spread a wide water hold through the channel; it answers in pushes, not shapes.

memory.fact: A wide water hold feels what moves in its free water as pushes against the hold, not as shapes.

event: Something heavy pushes back near the bank; you heave, and up comes a wicker trap packed with eels.

changes.note: The wide water hold and heave spend 10 mana

event: The wicker cracks and the trap bursts across the bank, eels writhing into the mud.

memory.fact: At 10:55 on day 2 Nala's water grab tore one of Jory's eel traps out and burst it; it's ruined.

event: Jory goes dark red. "That was a good one. One of the few I had left."

memory.fact: The eel trap Nala burst was one of Jory's good ones, and one of the few he has left.

event: "Sorry about that," you say. "You can call it even against the reedlurker."
"Even? One of those dead is worth more than wicker. Keep the skin, and the reeve's coin."

memory.fact: Jory calls the trap even: one dead reedlurker is worth far more to him than a wicker trap.
Jory wants neither the skin nor the bounty for the trap; she keeps both.

event: Eight traps on sixty yards, three still whole, each tied to a white peeled willow stake.

memory.fact: Jory has eight traps along sixty yards of this channel; three are still whole.
Each of Jory's traps is tied to a peeled willow stake on the bank, pale and easy to see.

event: By the first slide you bind earth and water again and send the ripple out gently, a shiver.

changes.note: A gentle sensing ripple spends 10 mana

event: This time you can read it: the empty den hollow, the channel water, weed and small quick lives.

memory.fact: An earth-and-water weave sent out as a ripple comes back as a felt shape of hollows and bodies.
A ripple returns as knowing, not sight: hollows feel empty, living bodies warm, heavy, stirring.

event: Forty yards up, under the second slide, lies a warm, heavy weight; at the ripple it goes rigid.

memory.fact: Nala's ripple from the first slide felt a lurker lying awake in the bank under the second slide.
An awake reedlurker feels a sensing ripple as a shiver and freezes in its den; it does not bolt.

event: Past fifty yards the ripple blurs into wet ground you can't tell apart.

memory.fact: A sensing ripple reaches about fifty yards through wet ground and water, and blurs past that.
Nala's earth-and-water sensing ripple reaches about fifty yards; past that it blurs.

event: You walk fifteen yards up the bank, past a white stake, until the second slide is in reach.
Your mud grip closes round the frozen weight; it thrashes, but the grip holds, heavy and slow.
The bank splits; the grip carries the reedlurker up and drops it on the bank, back from the water.

changes.note: The mud haul from the den spends 10 mana

memory.fact: Mud-hauled up through the bank, not out the water mouth, a lurker lands on dry reeds, off the water.
A reedlurker hauled straight out of its dry den has dry hide, warding only 1 against fire.

event: It rolls, hissing, for the channel; you bind fire and wind and throw the blast. It shrieks once.

changes.note: The blast's 10 mana is outrun by her mana's return over the turn
One hot-wind blast kills the Level 9 reedlurker

event: When the steam clears it lies still. [Prey Eliminated!] [Experience Gained!]

changes.note: The Level 9 reedlurker's kill earns her marks

memory.fact: Nala mud-hauled the Level 9 from its den and killed it with one hot-wind blast at 11:02 on day 2.

event: Jory whistles low. "Two. And the third's hole I've never found."
You spiral your search outward; a gentle ripple holds only water, weed and small quick lives.
Forty yards past the second slide you send another; near its edge it finds something.

changes.note: Two more sensing ripples spend 20 mana

memory.fact: Ripples walked up the channel find the third den once she's within fifty yards of the alder root.

event: Under a big alder a hundred yards up lies a warm, heavy weight, longer and denser, and asleep.

memory.fact: Nala's ripple found the third reedlurker asleep under a bank alder, 100 yards up the first slide.
By ripple the third reedlurker feels longer and denser than the other two.

event: Roots lace the wet earth round the den like a net; its only open way is the tunnel to the water.

memory.fact: A ripple feels the alder roots over the third den as a hard, knotted net in the wet earth.
Alder roots wrap the third den on every side; its only open way is the tunnel down to the water.

event: You walk up until the alder is well in reach; Jory follows ten yards behind.

memory.fact: While Nala hunts the Level 12, Jory follows ten yards behind her, well back from the water.

event: You bind water and fire and will the heat into the flooded tunnel; it heats, churns, then boils.

memory.fact: A steam weave heating a holt tunnel's water fills the den above with scalding steam in a minute.

event: Within a minute a white plume of steam hisses up from the air hole among the roots.

memory.fact: Steam in a den vents from its air hole as a white plume among the roots.

event: Something heavy thrashes under the bank, moves down toward the water, jerks, and stops halfway.

changes.note: The den-filling steam weave spends 10 mana
Scalding steam in its den kills the Level 12 reedlurker

event: The plume thins, and the bank under the alder is still. [Prey Eliminated!] [Experience Gained!]

memory.fact: Nala's den steam killed the Level 12 at 11:09 on day 2; its body lies in its tunnel under the roots.

event: [You have leveled up!] [You are now level 5!] [+2 Str] [+2 Dex] [+2 Vigor] [+4 Att] [+1 Luck]

changes.note: The Level 12 reedlurker's kill raises Nala to Level 5
Her marks carry past the level, leaving a little toward the next
Level 5 grants +2 Strength
Level 5 grants +2 Dexterity
Level 5 grants +2 Vigor
Level 5 grants +4 Attunement
Level 5 grants +1 Luck
Level 5 lifts her greatest health by 5
The level-up fills the new health
Vigor 17 lifts her greatest stamina to 54
The level-up adds the 6 new stamina

memory.fact: Killing the Level 12 reedlurker at 11:09 on day 2 raised Nala to Level 5.

event: [Starfall Surge Leveled Up! 3 > 4] [+3 Attunement]

changes.note: Use at 11:09 on day 2 raises Starfall Surge to level 4
Starfall Surge's level grants +3 Attunement
Attunement 55 lifts her greatest mana to four times it
The 28 new mana is added to what she held

memory.fact: Starfall Surge rose to level 4 from use at 11:09 on day 2, adding +3 Attunement.

event: The warm rush floods through you, and the pressure behind your breastbone deepens.

memory.fact: At Level 5 the warm rush came again, and the pressure behind her breastbone deepened.

event: Jory stares at the steaming roots. "Three. All three, before noon. But that one's under the roots."

memory.fact: Nala killed all three reedlurkers by Jory's traps before noon on day 2.

event: You close water round the body in the flooded tunnel and draw it down and out into the channel.

memory.fact: A water grip can draw a dead beast down a flooded tunnel and out into the channel; an easy act.

event: You heave it onto the bank by Jory: half again the others' size, scalded pink in patches.

changes.note: Her mana's return outruns the water grip's cost this turn

memory.fact: The Level 12's carcass is half again the size of the others, its hide scalded pink in patches.

event: "Three lurkers accounted for." Jory whoops; he'll tell the reeve, and you'll have his smoked eels.

memory.fact: Seeing the third body, Jory whoops, vouches for all three, and promises her a string of smoked eels.

event: "Thanks for the challenge! That was fun!" Jory laughs: "Fun, she says."
The two of you cross back over the Greyback and reach Fenwatch a little after noon.
At the Stag, Garrick heats the tub again; you pay him two copper and scrub off the fen.

changes.note: Garrick's hot bath costs two copper

memory.fact: He heats water for a wooden tub in the back room; a hot bath costs two copper.

event: Jory sits at the long table with Agathe, talking fast and waving his hands.
Agathe counts nine silver onto the table. "Three lurkers. On Jory's word."

changes.note: Agathe pays the three reedlurker bounties, nine silver
Her mana has filled again on the walk home and the bath

memory.fact: On Jory's word she pays the three reedlurker bounties as nine silver, counted out at the Stag.

event: You ask about Ghost-Eye on the slate. The hall goes quiet; Garrick stops wiping a mug.
"A Drakewolf, half again any other's size, with a milky left eye. It leads eight more."

memory.fact: Ghost-Eye, a big Drakewolf alpha with a milky left eye, leads a pack that holds the middle fen.
Ghost-Eye leads eight more Drakewolves, which hunt the middle fen at dawn and dusk.

event: "They hunt the middle fen at dawn and dusk; they herd their prey into the water, then cut it down."

memory.fact: Ghost-Eye is half again a common Drakewolf's size, and its pack herds its prey into the water.
Ghost-Eye's Drakewolf pack holds the middle fen and hunts it at dawn and dusk.

event: "It's killed two Sallow Hythe reed-cutters this summer, and it grows stronger every week."

memory.fact: It killed two reed-cutters from Sallow Hythe this summer.

event: "They den on a drowned-pine island half a day in. Twenty-five gold, at Antler Hall, on its head."

memory.fact: Its pack lairs on a dry island of drowned pines, half a day's wading into the middle fen.
Ghost-Eye's twenty-five gold bounty is paid only at Antler Hall in Wendlow, on its head.

event: "It's past anyone here to stand against. I'd not have you try alone."

memory.fact: Ghost-Eye grows stronger every week, and it is past anyone in Fenwatch to stand against.
Agathe would not have Nala go against Ghost-Eye alone.

event: Jory, quietly: "Rowan Coalby knows that ground best. His Sedge can follow them by scent."

memory.fact: In Fenwatch, Rowan Coalby knows the pack's ground best; his Sedge can follow its scent.
